meta.conforms_tps: 0.2.0 (v15), with D180.3's texts T-C3 and T-C4 as staged (tpm_d179_d180_d181_texts 0.1.0)
meta.module: tpc_strike 0.2.1 (proposed with TPC-PY 0.2.0; reads with tpc_zone 0.5.1's helpers, schema 0.5.0)
meta.note: Every expectation is hand-derived from the rule and the zone wording. The fixtures are the spring with its forms (examples/spring_draft.json), the zone corpus's toy and the tests corpus's FIX fixture, and one-change variants of them; test fixtures, not physics under research. Where a case is reachable only before the final pass its note says so. Both residences MUST reproduce every expect. 0.1.1 (schema 0.5.0; D176.1, D177.1): every fixture LAW carries a ROLE chosen by its physics (N2 EOM(v), KIN EOM(x), FREE_Z EOM(z)); sr3_scope reads no ROLE, so no expectation changed, and every final-pass status a note states holds under schema 0.5.0. 0.1.2 (S33, 2026-09-26): a LAW restating the motion of a FIXed or REMOVEd DOF carries ROLE CONSTRAINT (FREE_Z under C_NOZ; N2 and KIN where v or x is FIXed); a variant whose constraints leave z free gives FREE_Z EOM(z). No expectation moves. 0.1.3 (C-MS-5, increment 11, 2026-09-28): 11 decode/ cases, a JSON {} and [] and an object keyed 0 read as written in both residences; no earlier expectation moves.

ASSUMPTION.NAME: A_lin
ASSUMPTION.PROPOSITION: the restoring force is linear in x (Hooke régime)

ENTRIES.NAME: E_x
ENTRIES.IDENTIFICATION: x is the displacement from equilibrium along the spring axis
ENTRIES.FALSIFIER: a measured restoring force not proportional to x inside the domain

ENTRIES.NAME: E_v
ENTRIES.IDENTIFICATION: v is the time derivative of x
ENTRIES.FALSIFIER: a measured velocity differing from dx/dt beyond uncertainty

ENTRIES.NAME: E_z
ENTRIES.IDENTIFICATION: z is the height above the track
ENTRIES.FALSIFIER: any measured z different from 0

ENTRIES.NAME: E_t
ENTRIES.IDENTIFICATION: t is the laboratory clock reading
ENTRIES.FALSIFIER: two laboratory clocks that disagree beyond their stated uncertainty

PARAMETERS.STEP_CONVENTION: one application of an inference rule or algebraic identity is one step
